title: Histology images
ref: Wikimedia Commons (open licences, credited on each image)

images.title: Coagulative necrosis (myocardial infarct)
images.caption: Necrotic cardiomyocytes with hypereosinophilic cytoplasm and lost or fading nuclei, with the outline of the fibres preserved (H&E).
images.author: Katarzyna Michaud et al.

images.title: Fat necrosis (breast)
images.caption: Fat cells with clear lipid vacuoles and a foamy, lightly eosinophilic histiocyte with a small nucleus in a field of fat necrosis of the breast (H&E).
images.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.

images.title: Fibrinoid necrosis (polyarteritis nodosa)
images.caption: Small-vessel walls swollen and replaced by bright pink fibrinoid material with surrounding inflammation, in a skin biopsy of polyarteritis nodosa; four panels at increasing magnification (H&E).
images.author: Elsa Berardi et al.

images.title: Hepatic steatosis (fatty change)
images.caption: Hepatocytes containing large clear fat vacuoles that push the nucleus aside, concentrated around the portal tract (periportal macrovesicular steatosis, trichrome).
images.author: Nephron

images.title: Hemosiderin and lipofuscin
images.caption: Blue Prussian-blue granules of hemosiderin in a Kupffer cell versus golden-brown lipofuscin granules in a hepatocyte (iron stain; annotated).
images.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.

images.title: Psammoma body (meningioma)
images.caption: Whorled meningothelial cells with a round, dark, concentrically laminated calcified psammoma body at the left (meningioma, H&E).
images.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.

images.title: Intestinal metaplasia (Barrett esophagus)
images.caption: Goblet cells with pale, mucin-filled bluish vacuoles among columnar foveolar cells, showing intestinal-type metaplasia in incomplete Barrett esophagus (H&E).
images.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.

images.title: Caseating tuberculoid granuloma
images.caption: Epithelioid histiocytes and Langhans multinucleated giant cells ringing a zone of caseous necrosis (upper right) (H&E).
images.author: Humpath

images.title: Langhans giant cell in a granuloma
images.caption: A multinucleated giant cell with nuclei arranged in a peripheral horseshoe, within a granuloma of epithelioid histiocytes and lymphocytes (H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA

images.title: Non-caseating granuloma (sarcoidosis)
images.caption: Compact epithelioid granuloma with a giant cell containing an asteroid body, few lymphocytes and no necrosis (H&E).
images.author: Department of Pathology, Calicut Medical College

images.title: Acute appendicitis
images.caption: Low-power view of an inflamed appendix wall, with neutrophils infiltrating the muscularis propria and the periappendiceal tissue (H&E).
images.author: Nephron

images.title: Granulation tissue (healing infarct)
images.caption: Loose, vascular tissue of small new vessels, fibroblasts and mixed inflammatory cells replacing dead myocardium at the edge of a myocardial infarct (H&E).
images.author: Katarzyna Michaud et al.

images.title: Keloid
images.caption: Thick, glassy, hypereosinophilic bundles of collagen running haphazardly through the dermis beneath the epidermis (H&E).
images.author: DRdoubleB

images.title: Cervical dysplasia (CIN 3)
images.caption: Squamous epithelium replaced through its full thickness by crowded, atypical basaloid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and no maturation (CIN 3, H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA

images.title: Reed-Sternberg cell (Hodgkin lymphoma)
images.caption: A large binucleate cell with prominent nucleoli, the owl-eye Reed-Sternberg cell, amid a background of small lymphocytes (H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman, MD

images.title: Squamous cell carcinoma with keratin pearls
images.caption: Concentric whorls of pink keratin (keratin pearls) surrounded by atypical squamous cells in a laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA

images.title: Lipoma
images.caption: A nodule of mature adipocytes, each with a single clear vacuole and a flattened peripheral nucleus, beneath the surface mucosa (H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA

images.title: Leiomyoma (uterus)
images.caption: Interlacing fascicles of bland spindle smooth-muscle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei and nuclear palisading (H&E).
images.author: Ed Uthman from Houston, TX, USA
